author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Shuttle’s XPC nano NA20H series comprises three compact barebones mini PCs powered by AMD Ryzen and Ryzen AI processors. The 1-liter systems support up to 96GB DDR5 memory, four 4K displays, dual USB4 ports, and dual 2.5GbE networking, with select models featuring a 50 TOPS neural processing unit.
